formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : ℕ) (x2 : PEqualNP.AndCount.AndCountCircuit x1) (x3 x4 : Finset (Fin x1)), x3 ⊆ x4 → x2.eval x3 = Bool.true → x2.eval x4 = Bool.true
plain_statement: An AND-count circuit that is true at a vertex set is true at every larger vertex set.
title: A step toward: Petersen graph: some circuit with at most 6 AND gates, ORs free, is correct on its partial function with each variable bare in at most two gates
